slides.title: The spare Android in your drawer is a *working SMS gateway*.
slides.sub: Send and receive OTPs over a REST API in about five minutes, for nothing.

slides.quote: Paying per message before you have a single user is the wrong order.
slides.text: Verification is the first wall every MVP hits, and the usual answer is a paid account you cannot justify yet.

bullets: **Free.** No per-SMS cost, no paid account, no card.
**Send and receive** over a plain REST call or the CLI.
**Delivery status**, so you know the OTP actually landed.
**Webhooks** on incoming SMS -- end-to-end tests get easy.
**Five-minute setup.** No backend of your own to stand up.

Cloud-server mode, webhooks, delivery status and the dual-SIM flag -- the whole walkthrough is on the site, free to read.

caption:
An old phone with a SIM will send your OTPs for free. Mine has been doing it since I stopped paying for it.

Install one APK, turn on cloud mode, and you have a REST API: send, receive, delivery status, webhooks. Five minutes, no per-message bill, no backend.

Good for testing, internal tools and low volume. Not for bulk -- carriers throttle that, and they are right to.

Full walkthrough, curl included: hariomlohardev.github.io/tricks
